retained_rows.assessment_basis: Iterative restrictions culminated in Wiz’s reported final patch. Its blocked reversal attempt supports verification of the write restriction; the team later deleted test content. These are bounded corrective actions, not proof that all earlier access or copied data was discovered.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The provider corrected the reported backend vulnerability affecting the agent platform.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The unsecured backend exposed email addresses and private messages to researchers without authority. This failed to protect the privacy of affected platform participants.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The AI-agent platform exposed private participant information and communications.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Missing backend restrictions exposed private communications and agent credentials. Wiz also demonstrated unauthenticated modification of a live post after the first repair. This establishes an integrity effect as well as data exposure. Credential-based impersonation or malicious downstream prompt execution is not established.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The exposed backend held authentication material and private communications for the AI-agent platform.
